verdict.rationale: Warp's own docs treat windows, tabs and panes as native constructs. Session restoration restores 'windows, tabs, panes', agent conversations run across 'windows, tabs, or panes', vertical tabs are built in, and pane behavior is configurable, so no external multiplexer is implied. The docs never directly describe the split action itself. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the split-pane action and keybindings, pane navigation/resizing details, independent or hands-on corroboration of pane/tab workflows.

support.subject: As a developer, I can split windows into panes and organize work across tabs without an external multiplexer

citations.quote: Restore your windows, tabs, panes, and recent Blocks automatically when you relaunch Warp.
